صَفَارٌ , (S, M,) with fet-h, (S,) or ↓ صُفَارٌ , like غُرَابٌ, (K,) What is dry, of [the species of barleygrass called] بُهْمَى: (S, M, K:) app. because of its yellowness: (M:) it has prickles that cling to the lips of the horses. (TA in art. شفه.) ―
-b2- And the former, accord. to ISk, A certain plant. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
